text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Legend of Astrum.
text_block_list.orig_text: ──『レジェンドオブアストルム』。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: In the year 2033, this VR game became a worldwide hit due to its revolutionary quality and immersive feel. However...
text_block_list.orig_text:
西暦2033年、
正に革命的な完成度と没入感により世界中で大流行したVRゲーム。
……だが……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The ambitions and disputes of its developers, the Seven Crowns, led to a revolt by the super AI... the so known, "Minerva's Imprisonment". The resulting chaos erupted into a situation where the game's players were left unable to logout.
text_block_list.orig_text:
開発者である『七冠』たちの野望と諍いは、
超AIの反乱、
そして──
『ミネルヴァの懲役』、
プレイヤーのログアウト不能という大混乱を引き起こす。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Unaware that they were living in a world that was "created" and not their own, {0} and his friends deepened their bonds and lived their daily lives leading up to the fight against one of the Seven Crowns, Kaiser Insight, and the rogue avatar Eris, who had usurped Minerva and taken over as the World's Administrator.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}たちは、
世界が『創られたもの』だと知らぬまま
仲間たちと絆を深め、
ランドソルの王位を簒奪した七冠・覇瞳皇帝や
ミネルヴァと融合し世界の管理者となったアバター・エリスと戦う。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: After that...
text_block_list.orig_text: そして──

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Following a long adventure, {0} and his friends had finally reached the goal of their current journey: the Obsidian Palace, the center of Gio Nifhell, where the souls of the Lost players resided.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}たちは長い冒険の末、
ついに旅の目的──
ロストしたプレイヤーの魂が眠るという
ジオ・ニヴルヘルの中枢、
『黒曜宮』へと辿り着いた。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: But, what awaited them there was...
text_block_list.orig_text:
だが、
そこで待ち構えていたのは……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: N-Ninja arts...!?

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Then, this guy... you're telling me he's a ninja?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ、
このひとって──
忍者なのっ！？

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: No. There's no way any normal shinobi would be found in a place like this. Not to mention, he doesn't strike me as a resident of Gio Nivlhel either.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいや。
ただの忍びが、
こんな場所にいるはずがない。
ましてや、
ジオ・ニヴルヘルの住人というわけでもないようだし。

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: ...From what {0} has told me, he and the Seven Crowns were targeted by a certain organization in the "real world"...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……聞くところによると、
『現実』側では
{0}や七冠たちは
ある組織に付け狙われているとのことだけど……

text_block_list.name: Grenouille
text_block_list.text: Hmm. It seems you have a vague idea of who I am, I suppose that's a given.
text_block_list.orig_text:
フム。
当然こちらの素性は心当たりがあるか。

text_block_list.name: Grenouille
text_block_list.text: Allow me to properly introduce myself. I am...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらためて、
自己紹介をしておこう。
私は──

text_block_list.name: Guild Receptionist
text_block_list.text: ...Grenouille-san of the newly estabilished guild, "Warlock"? The evaluation of your quests results have been completed~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
──新設ギルド
【ウォーロック】の、
グルーヌイさ～ん？
クエスト結果の査定、
終わりましたよ～♪

text_block_list.name: Grenouille
text_block_list.text: My, I'm glad that you're such a diligent worker. Sorry for reporting so many quests back.
text_block_list.orig_text:
やぁ。
ずいぶん急いでくれたみたいで、
助かるよ。
たくさん持ち込んでしまって済まないね。

text_block_list.name: Guild Receptionist
text_block_list.text: No, no, I should be the one thanking you! You cleared so many difficult quests all by yourself, thank you so much! That said, this is amazing~...
text_block_list.orig_text:
いえいえ、
こちらこそ！
難しいクエストをたくさん解決してくれて、
ありがとうございます！
でも、
すごいですね～……

text_block_list.name: Guild Receptionist
text_block_list.text: From defeating a pack of wyverns to conquering the fortress of the sea god... Those are quests that even a party of veteran adventurers would have quite the hard time with, and you were able to flawlessly complete them on your own!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ワイバーンの群れの討伐に、
海神の砦の攻略とか……
ベテラン冒険者のパーティでも苦戦間違いなしのクエストを、
お一人で完璧にこなしちゃうなんて！

text_block_list.name: Grenouille
text_block_list.text: Merci beaucoup. To me it was more of a warm up exercise. What's more...
text_block_list.orig_text:
メルシー・ボクー
昔取った杵柄というものさ。
それに──

text_block_list.name: Grenouille
text_block_list.text: From now on, I'll have to deal with people who are much more formidable than monsters. I'm glad I was able to warm-up and recover my knack for fighting. After all, it's been about six months since I last dived.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これから先、
魔物などより余程手ごわい連中を相手しなくてはだからね。
勘を取り戻すことができて良かったよ。
なにせ約半年ぶりのダイブなものでね。

text_block_list.name: Guild Receptionist
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Umm...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ？
……え～っと……？

text_block_list.name: Grenouille
text_block_list.text: Ah, that was just me speaking out loud. Sorry, but it's almost time for me to meet up with someone, so... I think I'll excuse myself here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁ、
こちらの話だよ。
すまないがそろそろ人と落ち合う時間なのでね、
このへんで失礼させてもらおうかな。

text_block_list.name: Guild Receptionist
text_block_list.text: No, no, thank you for your hard work on all those quests! I look forward to your continued support!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いえいえ、
クエストお疲れさまでしたっ！
これからも、
ぜひよろしくお願いしま～す！

text_block_list.name: Grenouille
text_block_list.text: Yeah... me too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁ──
そうだね。

text_block_list.text: ...High-ranking agent Grenouille.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……グルーヌイ上級捜査官。

text_block_list.name: Grenouille
text_block_list.text: Hey, Roland. I hope your first quest went smoothly?
text_block_list.orig_text:
やぁ
ロランド。
初めてのお使いは上手くいったかな？

text_block_list.name: Roland
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed. As instructed, I've taken down about 50 of the target bandits, however...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ウス。
言われたとおり、
ターゲットの山賊どもを
50人ばかりのしてきましたが──

text_block_list.name: Roland
text_block_list.text: None of them are players... right? The sensation I had hitting them gave me that feeling...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あいつら全員、
プレイヤーではない……
んですよね？
殴った感触は、
どうしてもその……

text_block_list.name: Grenouille
text_block_list.text: They're NPC, Non-Player-Character, of course. To make it easier for you to tell them apart, I've added a code your helmet appropriate-... Whoops. My bad, I guess it's fair to say I've "enchanted" it, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
エヌ・ピー・シー。
もちろんノン・プレイヤー・キャラクターだとも。
判別できるよう、
そのメットに特殊なコード……
おっと。
『魔法』をかけておいただろう？

text_block_list.name: Grenouille
text_block_list.text: You're still a "noob", so let's avoid having you cause any "accidents". ...I've already adjusted your avatar in such a way where you won't lose your real-life skills by diving. I'm sorry for the short notice, but I'd appreciate it if you got used to it quickly.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まだ初心者の君が、
『事故』を起こしてしまわないように。
……ただでさえ君の能力に負けないよう調整した改造アバターだ、
時間のないところ済まないが、
早く慣れてもらわなくてはな。

text_block_list.name: Roland
text_block_list.text: ...Sure. I'll do my best.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ウス。
……善処します。

text_block_list.name: Roland
text_block_list.text: That said... is it really okay for us to act so relaxed? While we're here doing all of this, two players who should have been able to log out "over there" were...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ですが……
そんなノンビリしてて、
本当にいいんすか？
俺らがこうしてる間にも、
『あっち』じゃログアウトできたはずのプレイヤーたちが、
ふたた──

text_block_list.name: Yatogami
text_block_list.text: ...Roland. I understand your impatience.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──ロランド。
焦る気持ちはわかるがな。

text_block_list.name: Roland
text_block_list.text: ...! Chief...
text_block_list.orig_text:
！
局長……

text_block_list.name: Yatogami
text_block_list.text: It's just like I said during the briefing. This mission is of the highest importance, but also risky. It could be a one-way ticket. I can't just bring number-filling fodder in here with me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ブリーフィングで言ったとおり。
今回の任務は
重要度は高いが、
リスクも高い。
片道切符になるかもしれんのだ。
迂闊な数合わせは連れて来れん。

text_block_list.name: Yatogami
text_block_list.text: Therefore... when you're infiltrating a new country like this, make sure to research the local language and customs beforehand. Our first order of business is to get us used to this world.
text_block_list.orig_text:
故に──
潜入任務で、
あらかじめ現地の言葉や
風習を下調べするように。
まずは我々も、
この世界の法則に馴染むところから始めなくてはならん。

text_block_list.name: Grenouille
text_block_list.text: Ah, speaking of rules, Roland. Time is the last thing you should be worrying about. Faceless is already on the job, and most importantly... the way time works "here" is very different.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁ
法則といえばロランド。
時間の心配はさほど要らないよ。
フェイスレスが既に動いてくれているし、
何より──
認識時間が違う。

text_block_list.name: Grenouille
text_block_list.text: Before the imprisonment, in the world known as "Ver. 1", a day in "this" world was about 8 hours in the "real world"... but now it seems to have accelerated several times faster. Although it is still slower than the "Ver. 2" that had Kusano Yui's wish at its core.
text_block_list.orig_text:
懲役前、
『Ver１』の世界では『こちら』の１日が『あちら』の
８時間程度だったが、
現在ではさらに何倍も加速しているようだからね。
草野優衣を核とした『Ver２』の状態よりは遅くなっているが。

text_block_list.name: Roland
text_block_list.text: Sure... But wouldn't such a time gap mess with one's brain? I'm not aware of any method to strengthen the durability of what's inside my skull.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ウス……
けど、
そんな差があって
脳みそは混乱したりしないんですか？
頭蓋骨の内側の耐久性は、
鍛え方を知らないんですが。

text_block_list.name: Grenouille
text_block_list.text: That's not a problem... to a certain extent. Living things are quite flexible and tenacious, after all. Memory loss - a phenomenon in which forgetting things to protect oneself is quite common in such a circumstance.
text_block_list.orig_text:
多少は問題ないとも。
生き物というのは、
なかなかに柔軟でしぶといものだからね。
記憶喪失──
忘れることで自身を守る現象もままある話だ。

text_block_list.name: Grenouille
text_block_list.text: Ah, but of course? If one were forced to keep records of everything since the imprisonment had started, it's very possible they could go insane...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁ
もちろん？
懲役以降の、
全ての記録を保持させられたのなら発狂もありうるが──

text_block_list.name: Yatogami
text_block_list.text: Certainly... it's true that there's no time limit for this mission. However, that doesn't mean we can take as much time as we want. Some of the Seven Crowns have already dived in, not to add how there's an abundance of problems "over there".
text_block_list.orig_text:
確かに、
今回の任務に明確なタイムリミットは無い。
だが、
いくらでも時間をかけられるというわけでもない。
七冠たちの何人かは既にダイブしているし、
『あちら』の問題もある。

text_block_list.name: Yatogami
text_block_list.text: That said, leaving our top player Grenouille aside, it is essential for Roland and I to get used to this game and improve. In order to succeed in this mission...
text_block_list.orig_text:
しかし、
最上位プレイヤーだったグルーヌイはともかく
俺とロランドの場慣れと
上達は必要不可欠だ。
この任務を成功させるためには──

text_block_list.name: Yatogami
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, no. I suppose I should call it a "quest" instead of a mission? If I am to follow the rules of the town, that is...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……いや。
今は任務ではなく、
『クエスト』と言うべきか。
郷に従うのなら。

text_block_list.name: Grenouille
text_block_list.text: I think the fitting words to use here are "leveling up". ...How is your leveling going, Chief? Taking on the Tower of Sol solo with almost-initial level starting equipment seemed like the height of recklessness, but--
text_block_list.orig_text:
上達を、
『レベルアップ』というならより良いかと。
──レベリングは
順調ですかな局長？　
ほぼ初期レベルの
初期装備で
ソルの塔に
ソロで挑むなど、
無謀の極みに思えましたが──……

text_block_list.name: Yatogami
text_block_list.text: No big deal. I had a tough time in the early stages, but... I made it to the top without any problems. The good thing about this game is that I can bring over the motor reflexes, body control, and dynamic visual acuity I developed "over there".
text_block_list.orig_text:
なぁに。
序盤こそ苦戦はしたが……
頂上まで問題なく辿り着けたよ。
『あちら』で鍛えた運動反射や
体捌き、
動体視力を
そのまま持ち込めるのが
このゲームの良いところだ。

text_block_list.name: Yatogami
text_block_list.text: Besides, weapons and the like can be procured on the spot. Ah... I'd have to say opening a treasure chest was quite hilarious.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それに武器など、
その場で現地調達すればいい。
ああ……
宝箱を開けるのは、
少しばかり愉快だったがな。

text_block_list.name: Yatogami
text_block_list.text: Who on earth would go to the trouble of storing their weapons inside of a box in the middle of a labyrinth? I wonder what kind of adjustments have been made to the perceptions of the people in this world who don't even question such things... Hehe.
text_block_list.orig_text:
一体どこの誰が、
ご丁寧に武具を迷宮の箱に仕舞うというのか。
そんなことも疑問に思わないこの世界の者たちが、
どのような認識の修正を受けているのか……
フフ。

text_block_list.name: Grenouille
text_block_list.text: I'm glad you're enjoying yourself. However, judging by your reply, it seems that your other objective opposed to leveling - capturing Minerva - ended up in failure.
text_block_list.orig_text:
楽しんでいただけているようで何より。
しかしその様子ですと、
レベリング以外の目的──
ミネルヴァの確保は、
空振りに終わってしまったようですな。

text_block_list.name: Yatogami
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Unfortunately, there were no clues whatsoever to her whereabouts... With that being the case, we need to head directly to the facility that Faceless reported about, which stores the souls of dead players.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁ。
残念ながら、
行方を辿れる手がかりもない……
となると。
やはりまずは、
フェイスレスの報告にあった
プレイヤーの魂を格納するという施設へ、
直接向かう必要があるな。

text_block_list.name: Roland
text_block_list.text: Indeed. Rescuing the Lost players is our top priority miss-... "Quest", isn't it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ウス。
ロストしたプレイヤーの救出は、
最優先の任務──
クエストですからね。

text_block_list.name: Yatogami
text_block_list.text: ...You're right.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……そうだな。

text_block_list.name: Grenouille
text_block_list.text: The former Princess Eustiana and her crew are probably working towards the same purpose, though... Don't think we can cooperate with them, Roland. After all, the Seven Crowns are pulling the strings behind them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
恐らく
ユースティアナ元王女らも、
同様の目的で動いているだろうが……
協力しあえるとは思わないことだよロランド。
何せ彼女らの背後には、
七冠たちが糸を引いているのだから。

text_block_list.name: Roland
text_block_list.text: ...I know. Thanks to that fact, I've been forced to eat dirt when chasing them many times.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……わかってます。
おかげで何度も煮え湯を飲まされましたから。

text_block_list.name: Yatogami
text_block_list.text: Moreover, since we're "here", they have the upper hand. Even though they may look delicate, you never know what kind of skills they might have. And besides--
text_block_list.orig_text:
特に『こちら』では、
連中に一日の長がある。
華奢な見た目でも、
どんな技能を持っているかわからん。
それに──

text_block_list.name: Yatogami
text_block_list.text: It's just as Grenouille said. The most difficult task will be capturing the Seven Crowns after we're done dealing with the Princess. Even if it might seem a detour, it would be out of the question to neglect preparations.
text_block_list.orig_text:
グルーヌイの言った通り。
より骨が折れるのは
王女たちの後の──
七冠の捕獲だ。
たとえ遠回りでも、
準備を怠るなど以ての外だろう。

text_block_list.name: Grenouille
text_block_list.text: Good grief, that "Elder" really pulled a number on us. If only we had been able to wrap things up "over there", I would have been able to enjoy Legend of Astrum without any worries for the first time in a long time.
text_block_list.orig_text:
やれやれまったく、
『長老』も余計なことをしてくれたものですな。
『あちら』で事が済んでいれば、
久しぶりのレジェンドオブアストルムを
素直に、
心置きなく楽しむことができたというのに。

text_block_list.name: Roland
text_block_list.text: Leaving the "Elder" aside. If we're going to comment on their actions, I find what Vision Empress did more unforgivable...
text_block_list.orig_text:
『長老』もですが。
それを言うなら自分は、
幻境竜后のほうが許しがたいですが──

text_block_list.name: Yatogami
text_block_list.text: ...If the Seven Crowns are going to such lengths to knock each other down, that'd be perfect for us. We will not hesitate to take advantage of that opportunity.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──七冠どもが互いに蹴落とし合ってくれるなら、
願ってもない話だ。
我々は遠慮なく、
その隙を突かせてもらうとしよう。

text_block_list.name: Grenouille
text_block_list.text: For the sake of justice, I take it. Well then...
text_block_list.orig_text:
『正義のために』
ですな。
では──

text_block_list.name: Grenouille
text_block_list.text: It's about time we set out on an adventure. There are many special areas that were previously inaccessible in the former Legend of Astrum. They're piquing my interest.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そろそろ冒険へ繰り出すことにしましょうか。
かつてのレジェンドオブアストルムでは踏み入ることのできなかった
特殊エリアの数々──
実に興味をそそられる。

text_block_list.name: Yatogami
text_block_list.text: The location of the facility in question is in a world of discarded data... Though its name currently escapes me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
目的の施設のある場所は、
廃棄データの世界……
とのことだが。
名はなんと言ったかな。

text_block_list.name: Grenouille
text_block_list.text: The region's name is... "Gio Nivlhel". It is said to be an area similar to a netherworld, named after the dark land in the poems of the Ancient Edda.
text_block_list.orig_text:
region名称──
『ニヴルヘル』。
古エッダの詩編、
暗い国から名前を取った
冥府の如きエリアだそうですよ。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Although they were heading for the lowest level of the Obsidian Palace, our heroes were scattered all over the palace due to a teleportation magic circle created by the tentacles Grenouille controlled.
text_block_list.orig_text:
黒曜宮の最下層を目指していたものの、
グルーヌイの操る触手が作りだした転移魔法陣によって
宮殿のあちこちに飛ばされてしまった一同。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: {0}, Violet, Grace and Satsuki arrive at a strange underground space after descending a long corridor. What awaits them there is...
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}、
ヴァイオレット、
グレイス、
サツキは
長い回廊を下った末、
奇妙な地下空間へと辿り着く。
そこで待ち構えていたのは……

text_block_list.name: Violet
text_block_list.text: You're...!?
text_block_list.orig_text: あなたは……！？

text_block_list.name: Yatogami
text_block_list.text: ...Princess Eustiana isn't with you. I guess that means Faceless didn't go down without a proper fight.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ユースティアナ王女は、一緒ではないようだな。
フェイスレスの奴も、
只ではやられなかったということか。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. You seem to be a man of considerable standing, yet you lack the manners to introduce yourself?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……おう。
それなりの貫目の御仁と見受けるが、
名乗りの作法は知らねぇのかい。

text_block_list.name: Yatogami
text_block_list.text: Ah, pardon me. I'm the guild master of Warlock, Yatogami. ...If that's the kind of name you want from me in "this world", that is.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁ、
失礼。
俺は【ウォーロック】のギルドマスター、
ヤトガミという。
……『こちら』の流儀で名乗るならば、
な。

text_block_list.name: Yatogami
text_block_list.text: Princess Knight of Mosakuji Akira, I believe this is the first time we've met. You gave my subordinates quite the hard time, "over there".
text_block_list.orig_text:
模索路晶のプリンセスナイトとは、
初対面になるな。
『あちら』では
部下たちが、
世話になった。

text_block_list.name: Grace
text_block_list.text: Guild master... In other words, this man is the leader of Kishi-shi's enemies. That armored man by himself was already a monster... I see. Quite the formidable enemies you've found for yourself.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ギルドマスター……
つまりこの人物が、
騎士氏らの敵の元締めですか。
鎧の男も怪物じみていましたが──
成程、
迫力がありますね。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Praise for your righteousness, Yatogami-san. Name's Satsuki. The oni, Satsuki. My greetings. ...That said--
text_block_list.orig_text:
仁義あんがとよ。
ヤトガミさんよ。
俺ぁ鬼のサツキ
ってもんだ。
夜露死苦な。
……でもって──

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Standing in our path, as if to blocking the entry, in this underground maze we're in... What's the meaning of this? It's almost like you're trying to put a "no entry" sign our way... or maybe you don't know how to go deeper yourself.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんな地べたの底の底で通せんぼたぁ、
どういう了見だい。
立ち入り禁止の札でもなきゃ、
侵入るな
っつうのが
わかんねえわけでもあるめえに。

text_block_list.name: Yatogami
text_block_list.text: Good grief. I guess words are wasted if you're able to understand that much just by that... Well, whatever.
text_block_list.orig_text:
やれやれ。
口数を費やさなくては、
わからないわけでもあるまいに……
まあいい。

text_block_list.name: Yatogami
text_block_list.text: Grenouille--According to what my subordinate said, the giant crystal pillar sitting just ahead of us is the foundation that governs the system behind Gio Nivlhel. It's so heavily protected, even he's having trouble releasing its seal.
text_block_list.orig_text:
グルーヌイ──
俺の部下曰く。
このすぐ先に鎮座する巨大な結晶柱こそ、
ジオ・ニヴルヘルのシステムを
司る礎との事だが。
プロテクトが強固で、
解放に難儀しているそうでな。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...Well, aren't you the knowledgeable sort...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ずいぶんとまぁ、
詳しいじゃねぇか……

text_block_list.name: Yatogami
text_block_list.text: What's more--I have also received a report from another of my subordinates, Faceless, that your Princess has obtained the "key" to said seal. Therefore...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そして──
もう一人の部下、
フェイスレスからは
そちらの姫君が
封印の『鍵』を手にしたという報告も受けている。
故に……

text_block_list.name: Yatogami
text_block_list.text: Why don't you just hand it over. That key to the Obsidian Palace.
text_block_list.orig_text:
渡してもらおうか。
『黒曜宮の鍵』とやらを。

text_block_list.name: Violet
text_block_list.text: ...Lord Yatogami from Warlock. I am led to believe that you're also a visitor from another world, Landosol, just like Kishi-sama here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……【ウォーロック】の、
ヤトガミ様。
あなた様も、
騎士様たちと同じく
ランドソルという場所から参られた
来訪者と
拝察いたしますが──

text_block_list.name: Violet
text_block_list.text: Might your goal here be the same as Kishi-sama's? To rescue the souls of the many people who were unable to return home...
text_block_list.orig_text:
目的のほうも、
騎士様たちと
同じなのでしょうか？
還れなくなった数多の人々の魂を、
助け出したいと……

text_block_list.name: Yatogami
text_block_list.text: Of course it is. Otherwise, I wouldn't have come all the way down to this remote place.
text_block_list.orig_text:
勿論だ。
さもなくば、
こんな最果ての地まで降りたりはせんよ。

text_block_list.name: Yatogami
text_block_list.text: ...I can. If you intend to put down your weapons, I'm not reluctant to negotiate.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ああ。
そちらが矛を収めるつもりなら、
交渉は吝かではないとも。

text_block_list.name: Yatogami
text_block_list.text: You have my word we'll try to accomodate your wishes to our best "over there". It will be difficult to let all the charges of property damage and obstruction of justice go unpunished, but... If you're not okay with a public defender, we can introduce you to a lawyer.
text_block_list.orig_text:
『あちら』での今後も、
極力の便宜を取り計らおう。
器物破損、
公務執行妨害の数々を、
すべて不問にすることは難しいが……
国選でよければ、
弁護士も紹介してやる。

text_block_list.name: Yatogami
text_block_list.text: ...Very well. It seems my allies have already engaged with the troublesome Twinkle Wish, so it seems I'll have to stop you as fast as I can.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……いいだろう。
最も厄介な
【トゥインクルウィッシュ】とは
すでに交戦中のようだが、
直ちに手を止めさせるとも。

text_block_list.name: Yatogami
text_block_list.text: How about you, Princess? If you're here representing this world of yours, you should avoid a pointless path of conflict.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そちらの姫君は如何か？
世界を代表する者ならば、
無駄な争いの道は避けて通るべきではないかね。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...Tch.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……ちっ。

text_block_list.name: Grace
text_block_list.text: Master Yatogami--Hold on that thought.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヤトガミ氏──
少々お待ちを。

text_block_list.name: Violet
text_block_list.text: Grace...?
text_block_list.orig_text: グレイス……？

text_block_list.name: Grace
text_block_list.text: That subordinate of yours who reported back to you about this key... That's Freyja, the woman who infiltrated our castle, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
貴方に『鍵』の件を報告した部下とやらは、
我々の城に潜入したフレイヤという女性……
ですね？

text_block_list.name: Yatogami
text_block_list.text: Yeah. That's how she's known in "this world".
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ。
『こちら』では、
そう名乗っているそうだな。

text_block_list.name: Grace
text_block_list.text: In that case, we demand for her custody. Freyja attempted to assassinate me and the Princess, instilled falsehoods into the Princess's retainers to cause internal strife and deeply wounded our honored guests, like Princess Pecorine and her entourage.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ならば私たちは、
彼女の身柄の引き渡しを要求します。
フレイヤは
私と姫を暗殺し、
臣下たちに虚言を吹き込んで内紛を起こさせ
賓客であるペコリーヌ姫たちも深く傷つけられました。

text_block_list.name: Grace
text_block_list.text: Since things have escalated this much, it's hard to just forget all she has done under your watch. I wouldn't go so far as to take her life, but... Maybe we'll have her eat some shaved ice at the Eternal Glacier for a while?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここまでされてしまったら、
すべて不問にすることは難しいわ。
命を取るとまでは言わないけれど……
しばらく久遠氷河で、
かき氷でも食べていてもらおうかしら。

text_block_list.name: Yatogami
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm. Though she might've acted indipendently, my subordinates' misconduct is as good as my own. Even so, if you want to take custody of her---
text_block_list.orig_text:
……フゥム。
独断専行だったとはいえ、
部下の不始末は俺の不始末も同然だが。
それでも、
彼女の身柄を求めるというのなら──……

text_block_list.name: Yatogami
text_block_list.text: That boy over there... how about we trade her for him.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そちらの少年と、
交換といこうか。

text_block_list.name: Violet
text_block_list.text: You want Kishi-sama...?!
text_block_list.orig_text: 騎士様を……！？

text_block_list.name: Yatogami
text_block_list.text: If we consider this a hostage negotation, isn't that an appropriate level of exchange? Of course, your Princess here is the most valuable person around, however...
text_block_list.orig_text:
人質の交換とみるなら、
妥当なところではないかな。
この場の人間で最も価値があるのは、
当然ながら
そちらの姫君だが……

text_block_list.name: Grace
text_block_list.text: There's no way we'd ever hand her over. It'd be like trying to fish a whale with a krill.
text_block_list.orig_text:
渡すはずがないでしょう。
オキアミで鯨を釣られるようなものです。

text_block_list.name: Yatogami
text_block_list.text: It's a given why, you're an individual who is heavily involved with the Seven Crowns. --I'm sorry, but I can't make any more concessions.
text_block_list.orig_text:
無論のこと、
お前が七冠らに大きく関与する人物だからだ。
──悪いがこれ以上、
譲歩はできないぞ。

text_block_list.name: Grace
text_block_list.text: Kishi-shi...
text_block_list.orig_text: 騎士氏……

text_block_list.name: Violet
text_block_list.text: Kishi-sama......
text_block_list.orig_text: 騎士様……

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...Hold it, Little-Kishi.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──待ちな、
騎士公。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Don't "Huh?" me. Don't just believe what someone you just met says. Especially if he's that Freya's boss.
text_block_list.orig_text:
「えっ？」じゃぁねぇよ。
面ぁ合わせたばっかの奴の話を、
頭っから信じ込むんじゃねぇ。
フレイヤの親玉だっつんなら、
尚更だ。

text_block_list.name: Yatogami
text_block_list.text: Hoo. Then how can I prove myself to be more trustworthy? Maybe we should chat this over tea.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ホウ。
では、
どうすれば信じてもらえると？
茶飲み話でもすればいいのかな。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Hah. With a murderous aura as sharp as a blade, how about we cut the crap? ...You've been waiting for the chance to kill us all along, haven't you--
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハッ。
刃物みてぇな殺気飛ばしといて、
何言ってやがる。
端っから手前、
『そのつもり』だろうが──

text_block_list.name: Grace
text_block_list.text: ...Princess. You should step back a little. Kishi-shi, you too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……姫。
少し下がったほうがいいわ。
騎士氏も。

text_block_list.name: Violet
text_block_list.text: Wha-
text_block_list.orig_text: えっ──

text_block_list.name: Yatogami
text_block_list.text: ...! Impressive.
text_block_list.orig_text:
っ……！
やる。

text_block_list.name: Yatogami
text_block_list.text: With those slender arms, you've got a strength comparable to that of my subordinates--I'm impressed. I should be keenly aware that being bound by the laws of physics is pointless in this world.
text_block_list.orig_text:
その細腕で、
俺の部下に比肩する剛力とは──
驚きだな。
物理法則に囚われてはいけないと、
痛感する。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Tch... High time to be praising me. Are you the kind who looks tough only on the outside? Your sword technique is top notch, but the rest is just terrible.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちっ……
褒めてる場合かよ。
手前、
丈夫風はガワだけか？
太刀筋は上の上だが、
他はてんでじゃねぇか。

text_block_list.name: Yatogami
text_block_list.text: Ah. Then, let me try again...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁ。
では、
もう一手──

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...Hey. That's vastly different from what you did before. Did you go easy on me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……おい。
さっきとは別モンじゃねぇか。
手ぇ抜いてたってのか？

text_block_list.name: Yatogami
text_block_list.text: No. It's just... I've been able to "correct" my movements.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいや。
ただ、
動きを修正させてもらった。

text_block_list.name: Violet
text_block_list.text: ...Correct?
text_block_list.orig_text: ……修正？

text_block_list.name: Yatogami
text_block_list.text: After all, it's only been about five days since I got "this body". At first, I couldn't even sense the presence of this so-called magical power, but--
text_block_list.orig_text:
なにせ
『この身体』になって、
まだ５日程度なものでな。
最初は魔力とやらの存在すら感じられなかったが──

text_block_list.name: Grace
text_block_list.text: Kh...! Watch out, Kishi-shi!
text_block_list.orig_text:
！
危ない、
騎士氏……！

text_block_list.name: Grace
text_block_list.text: I accept your thanks. However...
text_block_list.orig_text:
御礼はツケで。
ですが……

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: "Shadow Blade" - as sharp as a sword.
text_block_list.orig_text:
影の刃──
カマイタチみてぇなもんか。

text_block_list.name: Yatogami
text_block_list.text: When I was a child, I dreamed of cutting things far away with a stick or emitting Qigong from my hands... but I never thought I would be able to put those fantasies into practice like this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
幼い頃。
棒切れで遠くのものを切断したり、
手から気功を放つことに
憧れたものだが……
こんな形で、
実践が叶うとはな。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: With each blow, the accuracy and power of his attacks increases immensely. This guy's...
text_block_list.orig_text:
一太刀飛ばすごとに、
精度も威力も段違いに増してきやがる。
こいつぁ……

text_block_list.name: Grace
text_block_list.text: ...Satsuki, I'll lend you a hand.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──サツキ。
手を貸すわ。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Don't be so conceited, Duchess Gre. Or so I'd like to say, but...
text_block_list.orig_text:
しゃしゃんな、
グレ公。
って、
言いてぇとこだが──

text_block_list.name: Grace
text_block_list.text: The opponent's strength is improving with every passing moment. And there is no sign of an upper limit... In that case, a quick defeat is the best course of action.
text_block_list.orig_text:
相手は一瞬ごとに、
実力を上げている。
しかも上限がまるで見えない……
となれば。
速攻が鉄板。

text_block_list.name: Grace
text_block_list.text: Kishi-shi, please. Please help us with your strengthening... and also protect the Princess.
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士氏。
お願いします。
私たちの強化と──
それと、
姫のお守りを。

text_block_list.name: Violet
text_block_list.text: Grace, don't push yourself...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
グレイス、
無理しないで……！
